config.query_normalization: (mean-token-state - feature mean) / sqrt(population feature variance + epsilon), no learned affine parameters

candidate_scoring: Restricted eight-color softmax at the final actual query position; fixed single-token candidates, no gold token or gold length in inputs.

prior_world_exclusions.identity_hash_serialization: UTF-8 JSON of sorted unique world SHA256 strings, separators=(comma,colon), no trailing newline

data_manifest.generation: Enumerate all 8^4 worlds, shuffle once with Python random.Random(seed); reject any base-plus-four-edits family intersecting either prior pretrained study or any accepted family; assign accepted families in train/validation/test order.
data_manifest.training: Original member only, all four public object queries per training family.
data_manifest.validation: Each arm selects its lowest mean restricted-eight-choice CE on original and targeted-counterfactual members.
data_manifest.test_views: Four paired presentations of the same test families: original, source-only shift, question-only shift, joint shift.
data_manifest.counterfactual: Only queried color advances one step in the fixed color cycle; other facts and the public query are unchanged.
data_manifest.nuisance: Only the next unqueried object's color advances; queried answer remains unchanged.
data_manifest.model_input_boundary: Only source strings, public query strings, and condition-specific complete text/symbolic strings are encoder inputs. Fact dictionaries, IDs, labels and query_key metadata are not model features.

validation_competence_gate.metric: Task-adapted full-text validation original/counterfactual record accuracy, required separately for every seed

advancement_targets.meaning: Predeclared engineering targets before considering efficiency studies; passing is not a novelty, universal-communication, or bandwidth claim.

structured_parser_oracle.role: Deterministic task-solvability check with complete structured facts; not an LM or a communication efficiency result.

uncertainty.cluster_unit: Original world family including four queries, edits and paired views
uncertainty.method: Average each family's four query scores across the fixed seeds; resample whole families with identical indices for all arms, views and contrasts.
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive 95% intervals conditional on these fixed seeds, not population-of-training-seed confidence. Other comparisons are secondary; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim.

public_question_encodings.question: The color of the apple is
The color of the book is
The color of the cup is
The color of the lamp is
According to the record, the apple has color
According to the record, the book has color
According to the record, the cup has color
According to the record, the lamp has color

interventions.private_source: Sorted-family successor derangement; coherent query and variant identity; identical across views
interventions.public_question: Cyclic next object question within the same template, replacing only the sender-side question vector
interventions.zero: Zero compressed slots before the trained receiver-side expansion

accounting.question_feedback_rule: Conservatively charge the full public question UTF8 bytes on each query-specific request; latent reply and framing are separate.
accounting.cache_scope: Each distinct source and public question encoded once across all splits/views/seeds/arms; only frozen model states cached, never trained bridge outputs.
accounting.uncached_cost_scope: Logical encoder call/token counts are reported; uncached wall time, network, framing, energy and full optimizer/activation memory were not measured.

limits: Small synthetic task and two fixed pretrained models; no new-method, universal-language or real-world agent-performance claim.
Private-constant retains the true public question but has structural zero paired correctness; beating it alone does not establish private fact transfer.
Question-dependent messages require question feedback and cannot reuse a world message across different questions.
Equal parameter/init/order/update budgets do not imply equal input lengths, FLOPs or wall time.
Family intervals are conditional on three fixed seeds; repeated queries, variants and views do not increase the independent family count.
Source and query interventions are label-free; wrong sources can coincidentally share the answer and wrong questions can leave predictions unchanged.
Frozen states are cached for actual execution. Logical uncached work is counted separately and is not a measured uncached latency.
All settings and advancement targets were fixed before held-out scoring; no posthoc tuning is justified by this run.
Eight-choice scoring does not measure open-ended generation. A two-byte symbolic representation makes a bandwidth-breakthrough claim inappropriate.
